observations: Side-by-side refrigerator with a dark silver/grey finish.
Samsung brand name is visible on the top right of the right-hand door in photo 0.
External water and ice dispenser with a digital display is present on the right door in photo 0.
Digital display shows temperature settings of -20 and 3 in photo 0.
Visible scratches and several small dents are present on the exterior of the right-hand door in photo 0.
Interior lighting is functional; freezer side (left) has blue LED lighting, fridge side (right) has white lighting in photo 1.
Interior shelves and drawers appear to be in place, though some show signs of wear or residue in photo 1.

claims.evidence: The display and interior lights are powered on, but there is no evidence that the unit reaches or maintains the set temperatures, or that the dispenser functions.

risks.risk: The cooling system (compressor/gas) may be faulty despite the digital display.
risks.proof: A photo of a thermometer inside the freezer showing a sub-zero temperature.

risks.risk: The water and ice dispenser may be non-functional or leaking.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the dispenser successfully outputting water and ice.

risks.risk: Door gaskets may be worn or torn, affecting efficiency.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the door seals all the way around.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification sticker (usually found on the inside wall of the fridge or on the back) to confirm the model number.
Video showing the water and ice dispenser in operation.
Photo of a thermometer inside the freezer and fridge to verify cooling performance.
response.reason: The model number is required to accurately identify the specific version and features of this Samsung refrigerator, which is necessary for pricing. Additionally, proof of cooling and dispenser operation is needed to move beyond a 'not working' valuation.
